Vinpearl Beachfront Nha Trang offers sea-view hotel apartments with signature comfort and direct access to Nha Trang Bay, complemented by a vibrant shopping center, upscale dining, a panoramic outdoor pool, and premium meeting spaces.
Spa
Vincharm Spa nurtures the body and soul with unique and effective massage treatments from natural ingredients, and skin and haircare services offered in modern Jacuzzi pools and hot & cold saunas. The time spent here will help you forget all about the chaos of everyday life and return to utter peace.
Discovery
Aquafield Nha Trang introduces visitors to the first Korean wellness complex in Vietnam. It provides a unique, luxurious retreat, promising unforgettable experiences.
The amusement park of ground-breaking records with adventure games, a water park with the most slides in Southeast Asia, virtual reality games, and many more.
An 18-hole, international-standard golf course with a width of 182 hectares, Vinpearl Golf Nha Trang is chosen as one among the Top 3 best golf courses in Vietnam.
Tram Huong Tower
Located on the busy Tran Phu street, Tram Huong tower has an extremely unique and new architecture, considered the most unique tourism symbol of Nha Trang.
Shopping mall
A modern shopping, entertainment and culinary space with world-class facilities that bring an enjoyable time for all visitors.
Nha Trang beach
The beautiful Nha Trang beach bends into a crescent shape embracing the emerald green bay with coconut and casuarina groves exalting the poetic beauty of this place.
